InfoSection.quote: Typography is the craft of endowing human language with a durable visual form.
InfoSection.author: Robert Bringhurst
InfoSection.question: What is Typelier?
InfoSection.description: Typelier is an independent typographic library for novels. Each system is manually researched, curated, and tested to find typefaces that work together both visually and functionally in long-form reading.
InfoSection.highlight: From fantasy worlds to literary fiction, each system considers genre, atmosphere, legibility, and the overall reading experience.

HowItWorks.title: How it works
HowItWorks.question: Every story deserves the right typography.
HowItWorks.description:
Typelier is a curated collection of typography systems for novels and long-form writing.

We research and combine free fonts from Google Fonts to help authors and designers find pairings that match the mood, genre, and voice of their stories.

Footer.title: Typelier
Footer.description:
Typelier is an independent, non-profit project.

All typography systems are manually researched and curated.

BookPage.title: Down the Rabbit-Hole
BookPage.body:
Alice was beginning to get very tired of sitting by her sister on the bank, and of having nothing to do: once or twice she had peeped into the book her sister was reading, but it had no pictures or conversations in it, “and what is the use of a book,” thought Alice “without pictures or conversations?”

So she was considering in her own mind (as well as she could, for the hot day made her feel very sleepy and stupid), whether the pleasure of making a daisy-chain would be worth the trouble of getting up and picking the daisies, when suddenly a White Rabbit with pink eyes ran close by her.There was nothing so very remarkable in that; nor did Alice think it so very much out of the way to hear the Rabbit say to itself, “Oh dear! Oh dear! I shall be late!”
